definitions.explanation: A person who raises dairy cattle and produces milk and other dairy products as their livelihood.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}には{酪農家|らくのうか}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many dairy farmers in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {酪農家|らくのうか}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{早|はや}くから{搾乳|さくにゅう}をする。
examples.english: Dairy farmers milk the cows from early every morning.

examples.japanese: {飼料|しりょう}{価格|かかく}の{高騰|こうとう}で、{多|おお}くの{酪農家|らくのうか}が{経営|けいえい}に{苦|くる}しんでいる。
examples.english: Due to soaring feed prices, many dairy farmers are struggling financially.

notes:
Composed of {酪農|らくのう} (dairy farming) + {家|か} (professional/practitioner). Hokkaido is the center of Japanese dairy farming, producing over half of the country's raw milk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酪農家|らくのうか}を{営|いとな}む: to run a dairy farm
- {若手|わかて}{酪農家|らくのうか}: young dairy farmer
- {酪農家|らくのうか}の{減少|げんしょう}: decline in dairy farmers
- {酪農家|らくのうか}を{支援|しえん}する: to support dairy farmers

RELATED WORDS:
- {酪農|らくのう}: dairy farming
- {畜産|ちくさん}: livestock farming — broader, includes all animal husbandry
- {農家|のうか}: farmer — general term for any farmer
- {牧場|ぼくじょう}: ranch/farm — the place where animals are raised
